description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawatta, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 52021
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about parcels of land (No. 132 of Block 14 and No. 158 of Block 03), their locations, cadastral maps, and amendments to land title particulars. The content focuses entirely on land registration matters, including modifications to encumbrances and expunging of particulars, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
